title: Board upgrade
summary: What the stage apps spike built in an hour, what you need to decide, and what comes next.

node.title: An app leaves its card and fills the board
node.body:
**Open** on an app card moves the panel to the top layer, under a thin bar. It is the same sandboxed frame, never reloaded, so the app keeps what it holds. **Esc** or **Back to card** returns it.

![The mission control app filling the board, one feed down](spike/stage.png)

node.title: A pick in the app becomes your note
node.body: The panel sends `vision-board/note` with its words. The board writes them as your note on the app's card, through the one action layer, so the agent reads it like any note.

node.title: The agent's reply shows inside the app
node.body: Each agent reply on the app's card is told to the running panel (`vision-board/notifications/reply`). The card is the app's mailbox, and the ledger records both directions.

node.title: Detail behind a triangle
node.body:
In a card's body, a line `+++ Label` opens hidden detail and a line `+++` closes it. Closed, the card is its title and a few lines. Open, the card grows and the cards under it move.

![A workflow card with its API detail opened: an endpoint and a small table](spike/detail.png)

node.title: Where to see it running
node.body:
This board runs the main checkout, so the app card here shows the feeds but has no Open and can't raise a note.

The spike runs beside it: **http://localhost:4520/?board=stage-demo**

- Branch `spike/stage-apps`, worktree `.claude/worktrees/stage-apps`
- Nothing is committed
- The feeds are simulated inside the panel: no keys, no network

node.title: An app writes your note without asking
node.body:
Today a press of Raise in the app is enough: the note is written in your name with no confirm on the board. Free, but an app could write notes you did not mean.

✓ keep it direct · ✗ the board asks before each note

node.title: The stage covers the whole page
node.body:
On stage the app covers the toolbar and the chat panel too. Simpler and more room, but you can't chat while it is open.

✓ keep the whole page · ✗ fill only the board area, chat stays

node.title: How an agent writes hidden detail
node.body:
The spike uses a Markdown fence, `+++ Label`, so nothing in the ledger format changes. The other way is a `detail` field on the node, which is a format change but lets the board count and search it.

✓ keep `+++` · ✗ a `detail` field on the node

node.title: Panels may play video and audio
node.body:
An app's manifest already names the hosts its images and fonts come from. The spike lets the same hosts serve video and audio, which a player needs.

✓ keep one list · ✗ a separate list for media

node.title: Build it properly next
node.body:
The spike skips the gallery entries, page specs, WebKit and a proper task. Building properly means Cortex tasks written from what you ticked here.

✓ write the tasks · ✗ keep playing first

node.title: Icons and logos on cards
node.body: Your idea from mid-build, not built. A card could name an icon or a logo from the ledger's `images/` folder, drawn beside its title, so a product or a system is recognised at a glance.

node.title: Not checked yet
node.body:
- nclite's WebKit window: the stage uses the popover top layer
- Keyboard and screen reader on stage: focus is not held inside it
- Whether a panel stuck in a loop can freeze the board
- The full page suite was still running when this was drawn

node.title: Live data is not a stream yet
node.body: The agent reaches a running app only through replies on its card. Real feeds (Uplynk, Zixi) need the app's tools with keys in `.env`, and a stream from server to panel, which is not built.

node.title: Read-only after a restart is by design
node.body: `npm run board` always opens read-only. `VB_EDIT=1 npm run board` (or `--edit`) opens it for editing, so a restart no longer drops it.

node.title: Not checked yet
node.body:
- nclite's WebKit window: the stage uses the popover top layer
- Keyboard and screen reader on stage: focus is not held inside it
- Whether a panel stuck in a loop can freeze the board
- The full page suite was still running when this was drawn

**Page suite, finished:** 990 passed, 13 failed, 10 did not run. The failures are app card and gallery specs (screenshots, and the smallest app card's one-line footer). The new Open button in the footer is the likely cause; I have not gone through each one.
